components.name: Mobile Client
components.purpose: Maintains a connection and durable local message IDs/cursors.

components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Authenticates requests and routes chat and media operations.

components.name: Connection Server
components.purpose: Owns live connections and a short-lived connection directory.

components.name: Message Service
components.purpose: Deduplicates sends, persists messages and schedules delivery.

components.name: Message Database
components.purpose: Stores conversations, membership, ordered messages and device cursors.

components.name: Durable Message Queue
components.purpose: Buffers delivery work; messages remain recoverable from durable storage.

components.name: Presence Cache
components.purpose: Caches expiring connection ownership and presence, not authoritative message history.

components.name: Object Storage
components.purpose: Stores encrypted or access-controlled media blobs.

components.name: CDN
components.purpose: Serves authorized media through bounded signed URLs.

Justify connection cost and mobile network recovery.

alternatives: User inbox ownership with a conversation sequencer
tradeoffs.guidance: Explain the ordering and fanout consequences.

dataModel.notes: Deduplicate client IDs within a sender/conversation namespace.
Authorize reads and group fanout against membership.
Monotonic cursors enable replay and gap detection.

flows.name: Send and replay
steps: Client sends a stable message ID over an authenticated connection
Message service deduplicates and persists before accepting
Durable delivery work routes to current connections or offline notification
Reconnecting devices replay after their stored cursors and acknowledge receipt

flows.name: Media
steps: Client uploads media to authorized object storage
A chat message carries a blob reference rather than the bytes
Recipients request short-lived authorized download links
